title: Breast Cancer Risk Stratification - Clinical Feature Schema
description: Clinical diagnostic feature schema defining the 30 standardized fine needle aspiration (FNA) cytological features required by the trained classifier.

features.name: radius_mean
features.description: Mean distance from nucleus center to perimeter points

features.name: texture_mean
features.description: Mean of gray-scale values (standard deviation of gray-scale)

features.name: perimeter_mean
features.description: Mean cell nucleus perimeter

features.name: area_mean
features.description: Mean cell nucleus area

features.name: smoothness_mean
features.description: Mean local variation in nucleus radius lengths

features.name: compactness_mean
features.description: Mean compactness (perimeter^2 / area - 1.0)

features.name: concavity_mean
features.description: Mean severity of concave portions of contour

features.name: concave points_mean
features.description: Mean count of concave portions of contour

features.name: symmetry_mean
features.description: Mean nucleus symmetry

features.name: fractal_dimension_mean
features.description: Mean fractal dimension coastline approximation

features.name: radius_se
features.description: Standard error of cell nucleus radius

features.name: texture_se
features.description: Standard error of gray-scale values

features.name: perimeter_se
features.description: Standard error of cell nucleus perimeter

features.name: area_se
features.description: Standard error of cell nucleus area

features.name: smoothness_se
features.description: Standard error of local variation in radius lengths

features.name: compactness_se
features.description: Standard error of compactness

features.name: concavity_se
features.description: Standard error of concavity

features.name: concave points_se
features.description: Standard error of concave portions count

features.name: symmetry_se
features.description: Standard error of cell nucleus symmetry

features.name: fractal_dimension_se
features.description: Standard error of fractal dimension approximation

features.name: radius_worst
features.description: Largest (worst) cell nucleus radius

features.name: texture_worst
features.description: Largest (worst) gray-scale value variation

features.name: perimeter_worst
features.description: Largest (worst) cell nucleus perimeter

features.name: area_worst
features.description: Largest (worst) cell nucleus area

features.name: smoothness_worst
features.description: Largest (worst) local variation in radius lengths

features.name: compactness_worst
features.description: Largest (worst) compactness measurement

features.name: concavity_worst
features.description: Largest (worst) severity of concave contour portions

features.name: concave points_worst
features.description: Largest (worst) number of concave contour portions

features.name: symmetry_worst
features.description: Largest (worst) symmetry measurement

features.name: fractal_dimension_worst
features.description: Largest (worst) fractal dimension approximation
